goal: Identify the curve 68 RawTherapee profiles share and ship a default tone curve for profiles that carry none
notes: Duplicate of PR #15054 (merged while this run worked): both runs took the photo-editing BUILDABLE item 'default tone curve for profiles with none'. allocate.py showed 'open PRs naming it: 0' at the start, and this run opened its PR only after the work was done, not as a draft claim at the start. Both runs found the same result: the shared 8,192-point curve is the ACR default table, and both fitted their own spline. Main's 20-knot fit measures as well or better on the real 5D Mark II frame (max 0.81, mean 0.014 8-bit steps) as this run's 16-knot fit (max 0.81, mean 0.039), so PR #15061 was closed unmerged. Only this record lands. Measured here: an 8-knot fit weighted only on the grey axis (linear error 3.3e-3) was 14 8-bit steps off in saturated sky, so the linear error bound matters. Main's README already says the matrix amplifies these gaps.
